A Week 13 NFL game between the Jacksonville Jaguars and the Tennessee Titans at Nissan Stadium in Nashville, Tennessee on November 30, 2025. The Jaguars went on to beat the Titans 25-3. Taken from the south end zone in Section 123, Row C, with an iPhone 13 Pro.
